reason: The README describes a project-management layer that groups folders and sessions while sharing project instructions and memory across conversations, making memory-context the primary category.

summaries.zh: 将多个文件夹和会话组织为项目，并通过项目级指令与共享记忆提供跨会话上下文。
summaries.en: Organizes folders and sessions into projects while providing shared project instructions and memory across conversations.

capabilities: organizes folders and sessions into project entities
stores project metadata and shared Markdown files locally
injects project instructions into system prompts
injects shared project memory into session messages
provides project memory read and write tools
adds a sidebar and project management panel
